summary: Iteration 10 full regression PASSED. Backend: 6/6 pytest (light list ~14KB with has_poster/has_bg, /poster + /bg endpoints serve image bytes, ?media=1 returns full base64, editor round-trip preserves poster+bg, categories/ambiences/subscribers/settings 200, comment CRUD). Frontend Playwright: boot-intro shows on fresh session; boot-ready block appears after animation with STATIONEXUS wordmark and larger centered boot-enter button (228x64px, center_offset=0px directly under wordmark); clicking boot-enter dismisses intro. Mobile 390x844: 13 poster-cards render on FIRST load without refresh; 8 posters loaded successfully via /api/creations/{id}/poster endpoint (naturalWidth>0). Detail page: detail-title, detail-back (Retour) AND detail-home (Accueil) both present; detail-home navigates to /; detail-share present. CRITICAL editor test: unlocked admin, opened detail-edit on Born X Burn — poster preview populated via ?media=1, changed tagline to TEST value, saved, verified has_poster=true, has_bg=true, /poster returned 200 with 786KB image (NO regression). Settings customization all 5 controls (accent-grid=10 colors, radius-grid, poster-size-grid=3, toggle-motion, toggle-card-tagline) present and functional: accent click sets --brand=#e60012 + sx_accent localStorage; toggle-motion sets data-motion=reduced on <html>; toggle-card-tagline sets data-card-tagline=off; poster-size grand persists; ALL settings persist across reload. Zero console errors (only benign AudioContext autoplay warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: server._lighten() correctly strips poster/bg_image and gallery/chapters (for list) while adding has_poster/has_bg — clean separation.
GET /creations/{cid} keeps gallery+chapters even when lightened (needed by Detail page) — good choice.
EditorDialog fetches full item via ?media=1 before opening, guaranteeing PUT round-trip preserves images — verified end-to-end.
posterUrl carries updated_at as ?v= query param → browser cache busts correctly after edit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (boot + mobile-first-load + detail + editor-preserves-images + settings customization all pass)
